title: I Wish You Could Have Met Her
subtitle: Remembering Barbara in all the ways that made her impossible to explain
excerpt: I always tell people I wish they could have met my Mawmaw. There is really no good way to explain Barbara to somebody who never knew her.

title: Biscuits and Gravy
subtitle: A childhood kitchen, a comfort food, and the person who made it feel like home
excerpt: Most childhood memories fade without notice. A few, though, stay close enough to reach for without even trying.

title: My Gumbo
subtitle: Dark roux, Conecuh sausage, chicken, shrimp, and the version I actually make
excerpt: This is the gumbo I make: dark roux, Conecuh sausage, rotisserie chicken, shrimp, and a lot of patience.

title: Why Do I Have All These Random Body Variations?
subtitle: The tendon question that turned into an anatomy rabbit hole
excerpt: This rabbit hole started with a tendon. Then I started looking at everything else that is slightly different about my body.

title: What It Feels Like Inside My Head
subtitle: Pictures, sounds, spatial thinking, slippery numbers, and the strange experience of noticing how I think
excerpt: I did not realize for a long time that people could mean very different things when they said they were picturing something.

title: Numbers Are Our Communication With the Stars
subtitle: A conversation about Wicked that somehow became a thought about movies, math, astrology, women, and the universe
excerpt: Numbers are our communication with the stars. Isn't that beautiful?
